Bill.BriefDescription: Allowing third parties to write permits for transportation projects.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to third party permit writing for transportationprojects; amending RCW 47.01.290; adding a new section to chapter47.06C RCW; and adding a new section to chapter 47.01 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 47.01.290 and 1994 c 258 s 3 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The legislature recognizes that environmental review oftransportation projects is a continuous process that should begin atthe earliest stages of planning and continue through final projectconstruction. ((Early and extensive involvement of the relevantenvironmental regulatory authorities is critical in order to avoidsignificant changes in substantially completed project design andengineering.)) Streamlining the permit writing and approval process isessential for reducing project delays and for making the most efficientuse of every transportation dollar. It is the expectation of thelegislature that if a comprehensive environmental approach isintegrated throughout various transportation processes, onerous,duplicative, and timeconsuming permit processes will be minimized.The legislature finds that the greatest efficiency and effectiveness in p. 1 HB 2608expediting the permit writing process will include the inclusion ofqualified private sector parties in the preparation of required projectpermits.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 47.06C RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) By June 30, 2004, the committee shall develop guidelines for acertification program to enable third party persons to draftenvironmental permits. (2) By January 1, 2005, the departments of transportation, ecology,and fish and wildlife shall, using the guidelines developed by thecommittee, develop rules that allow a third party writer to writepermits that the department of ecology and the department of fish andwildlife are responsible for issuing. The rules may address permitwriting requirements, qualifications of the third party in writingpermits, and other requirements. (3) The permit writing process must provide that the appropriateresponsible agency for permit issuance will have a single review periodfor review of the permit drafted by the third party. The agency shallprovide any comments or suggested revisions to the permit writer withinsixty days of the draft permit being provided to the agency. If thethird party writer complies with the original guidelines and rulesestablished by the permitting agency and addresses comments by theagency and any suggested revisions, the permit must be approved by theagency within ten days of the permit being resubmitted to the agency.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 47.01 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) If the transportation permit efficiency and accountabilitycommittee is not funded or ceases to exist, the departments oftransportation, ecology, and fish and wildlife shall by January 1,2005, jointly develop rules that allow a third party writer to writepermits that the department of ecology and the department of fish andwildlife are responsible for issuing. The rules may address permitwriting requirements, qualifications of the third party in writingpermits, and other requirements. (2) The permit writing process must provide that the appropriateresponsible agency for permit issuance will have a single review period HB 2608 p. 2 for review of the permit drafted by the third party. The agency shallprovide any comments or suggested revisions to the permit writer withinsixty days of the draft permit being provided to the agency. If thethird party writer complies with the original guidelines and rulesestablished by the permitting agency and addresses comments by theagency and any suggested revisions, the permit must be approved by theagency within ten days of the permit being resubmitted to the agency.
